$comment: Pattern data for scan.mjs; references/patterns.md documents every id. Regexes compile with the u flag (giu, or gu when caseSensitive): escape only syntax characters, and double every backslash in JSON. Directory globs need **/ to match at any depth.

prose.desc: Default for pasted text and unmatched paths.

chat.desc: Messages to a person: Slack, DMs, forum replies.

ui.desc: In-app strings: labels, alerts, onboarding, errors.

social.desc: Posts for X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads.

legal.desc: Privacy policy, terms, EULA. Findings cap at warn; never rewrite without counsel.

rules.name: Assistant opener
rules.regex: (?:Certainly|Absolutely|Of course|Sure thing|Sure|Gladly|Great question|Good question|Excellent question|Great catch|Good catch|Great point|Good point|Great idea|What a great question)!|(?:Great|Good|Excellent|Fantastic|Interesting) question[.,]|(?:Certainly|Absolutely)[,.](?=\s+(?:here|I|let|below|the following))
rules.fix: Delete the opener and start with the answer.

rules.regex: \byou(?:['’]re| are) (?:absolutely|completely|totally|entirely|exactly|quite) (?:right|correct)\b|\bI (?:sincerely )?apologi[sz]e for (?:the|my) (?:confusion|oversight|error|mistake|misunderstanding)\b|\bthank you for (?:pointing (?:that|this) out|catching (?:that|this))\b|\bthat(?:['’]s| is) (?:a |an )?(?:great|excellent|fantastic|brilliant|insightful) (?:question|point|observation|catch)\b
rules.fix: Cut the agreement or apology; state the correction itself.

rules.regex: \b(?:I )?hope (?:this|that|it|the above) (?:helps|was helpful|is helpful|clarifies|answers)\b|\banything else (?:I can|you(?:['’]d| would) like me to) (?:help|assist|do|explain)\b|\bwould you like me to\b|\bdo you want me to\b|\bshall I (?:go ahead|proceed|continue|also)\b|\bI(?:['’]d| would) be (?:happy|glad|delighted) to (?:help|assist|explain|elaborate|walk you through|provide)\b|\b(?:happy|glad) to help\b|\bhappy (?:coding|writing|learning|building|reading)!|(?<=^|\n|[.!?:]\s+)want me to (?:continue|proceed|go ahead|add|expand|elaborate|give|write|draft|make|include)\b|\bshould I (?:continue|proceed|go ahead)(?:(?: with| and) [^.?!\n]{1,40})?\?|\bshould I (?:expand|elaborate) on (?:this|that|it|any)\b

(?:version|draft|rewrite|edit|text|copy|paragraph|email|message|summary|README|description)\b

rules.name: Source-availability hedge

rules.name: Reasoning narration
rules.regex: \blet(?:['’]s| me) think (?:this through|step by step|about (?:this|it) (?:step by step|carefully|systematically))\b|\b(?:here['’]s|this is) my (?:thought process|reasoning process|chain of thought)\b|\bto approach this systematically\b|\bworking through this (?:logically|step by step|systematically)\b|\blet me (?:break (?:this|it) down|walk you through (?:this|it|my))\b|\bbreaking (?:this|it) down(?: step by step)?:

rules.name: Era-setting opener
rules.regex: \bin today['’]s (?:(?:fast-paced|fast paced|ever-changing|ever-evolving|rapidly changing|rapidly evolving|digital|modern|interconnected|hyper-connected|hyperconnected|competitive|busy|hectic|data-driven|tech-driven|technology-driven|always-on|online|evolving|dynamic|crowded|noisy|complex|increasingly [\p{L}-]+) )+(?:world|age|era|landscape|society|environment|market|marketplace|economy|business world|workplace|climate|times)\b|\bin today['’]s world\b|\bin (?:the|an|this|today['’]s) (?:ever-evolving|ever-changing|rapidly evolving|rapidly changing|constantly evolving|constantly changing|fast-paced|fast-moving) (?:world|landscape|realm|field|space|era|industry|market|environment)\b|\bin an (?:era|age|world) (?:of|where|when|defined by|dominated by)\b|\bin the (?:modern|digital|information) (?:age|era)\b|\bnow more than ever\b

rules.regex: \b(?:stands|stood|serves|served|remains|remained|acts|stand|serve|remain) as (?:a |an )?(?:[\p{L}-]+ )?(?:testament|reminder|beacon|monument|embodiment|cornerstone|hallmark|bastion|linchpin|catalyst)\b|\b(?:a|an) (?:true |living |lasting |enduring |powerful |fitting |clear )?testament to\b|\ba (?:stark|powerful|poignant|timely|vivid|sobering|potent|humbling|gentle) reminder (?:of|that)\b|\b(?:paints|painted|painting) a (?:vivid|clear|compelling|stark) picture\b

rules.name: Importance assertion
rules.regex: \bplay(?:s|ed|ing)? (?:a |an )?(?:crucial|pivotal|vital|key|critical|significant|essential|central|instrumental|integral|important|major|fundamental|paramount|decisive|indispensable) (?:role|part)\b|\b(?:is|are|remains|becomes|become) (?:absolutely |increasingly |more )?(?:crucial|pivotal|vital|essential|paramount|imperative|indispensable) (?:for|to|in) (?:the |a |an |your |any |every |our )?(?:success|growth|future|development|understanding|achieving|ensuring|maintaining|navigating)\b|\bcannot be (?:overstated|understated|overemphasi[sz]ed)\b|\bof (?:paramount|utmost|pivotal) importance\b|\b(?:marks|marked|marking|represents|represented) a (?:pivotal|significant|major|key|watershed|defining|turning|critical|crucial|historic) (?:moment|shift|milestone|step|turning point|chapter|point)\b|\bset(?:s|ting)? the stage for\b|\b(?:underscores|highlights|reinforces) (?:its|the|their) (?:importance|significance|role|value)\b

rules.regex: \bsomething went wrong\b|\b(?:an|unknown|unexpected) error (?:has )?(?:occurred|happened)\b|\b(?:oops|whoops|uh[- ]oh)\b|\bplease try again later\b
rules.fix: Say what failed and what the person can do: "Couldn't save the photo. Check your connection, then try again."

rules.name: Aphorism formula
rules.regex: \b(?:is|are|becomes|become|remains) the (?:new )?(?:language|currency|architecture|grammar|operating system|oxygen|lifeblood|DNA|heartbeat|soul|fabric) of\b|\bnot (?:a|an) [\p{L}-]+,? but (?:a|an) (?:mirror|lens|window|map|compass|practice|verb|conversation|promise|invitation)\b|\bat (?:its|their) (?:very )?core,
rules.fix: Say the literal claim the metaphor stands for.

rules.name: Blame wording in UI
rules.regex: \b(?:invalid|illegal)\b
rules.fix: Say what is expected: "Enter an email address like name@example.com."

rules.name: Document narration
rules.regex: \bthis (?:article|post|blog post|guide|tutorial|piece|essay|section|chapter|thread|video|write-up) (?:will )?(?:explores?|discuss(?:es)?|covers?|walks? (?:you )?through|takes? (?:you on )?a (?:closer |deep |deeper |quick )?look at|examines?|unpacks?|breaks? down|dives? into|delves? into|aims to|sets out to)\b|\bby the end of this (?:article|post|blog post|guide|tutorial|piece|section|chapter|thread|video)\b|\b(?:in|throughout) this (?:section|chapter|thread|video),? (?:we|I|you)(?:['’]ll| will) (?:explore|discuss|cover|look at|learn|examine|unpack|break down|go over|walk through|dive into)\b
rules.fix: Cut the sentence about the text and start with its first point.

rules.name: Control reassurance
rules.regex: You(?:['’]re| are) (?:always |still |fully |completely |totally |firmly |entirely )?(?:in (?:full |complete |total |sole )?(?:control|charge|command)(?!\s+of\s+(?!(?:every|each|all|any|your|what|how|when|which|whether)\b))|in the driver['’]s seat|the boss|the one in charge|in the loop|calling the shots)|You (?:always |still )?(?:stay|remain|keep|are kept) (?:always |fully |firmly |completely )?(?:in (?:full |complete |total |sole )?(?:control|charge|command)(?!\s+of\s+(?!(?:every|each|all|any|your|what|how|when|which|whether)\b))|in the driver['’]s seat|in the loop)|You (?:always |still )?(?:call the shots|have the (?:final|last) (?:say|word)|get the (?:final|last) (?:say|word)|have (?:full|complete|total|final|the final) (?:control|say|authority|ownership))|You (?:always |still |alone )?(?:decide|choose|approve|own it|own them)[.!]|You (?:always |still |personally |alone )?(?:approve|sign off on|okay|ok|confirm|green-?light|vet|authori[sz]e|review|control) (?:every|each|all|any) (?:single )?(?:change|step|action|edit|move|decision|plan|operation|update|deletion)s?\b|Nothing (?:happens|changes|moves|runs|gets (?:deleted|changed|moved)|is (?:deleted|changed|moved)) (?:without your (?:say-?so|sign-?off|approval|okay|ok|permission|consent)|until you say so)|Your [\p{L}’'-]+(?: [\p{L}’'-]+)?, your (?:rules|call|choice|way|terms|say)\b|Your [\p{L}’'-]+(?: [\p{L}’'-]+){0,2} (?:stays?|remains?) (?:always |still )?(?:yours|in your hands|under your control)\b|The (?:choice|decision|call|final say) is (?:always |still |entirely )?yours\b|It['’]s (?:always |entirely )?your (?:call|choice|decision)[.!]
rules.fix: Name the mechanism instead: who proposes the change, where the reader approves it, and how it is undone.

rules.name: Denial pivot
rules.regex: \b(?:it|this|that|they|these|those|he|she|we|you|[\p{L}-]+)(?:['’]s|['’]re| is| are| was| were) not (?:just|only|merely|simply|about|really about|even about) [^.!?;\n]{1,60}?[,;:—–.]\s*(?:it|this|that|they|these|those|he|she|we|you)(?:['’]s|['’]re| is| are| was| were)\b|\b(?:isn['’]t|aren['’]t|wasn['’]t|weren['’]t|doesn['’]t|don['’]t|didn['’]t) (?:just|only|merely|simply|really about|even|about) [^.!?;\n]{1,60}?[,;:—–.]\s*(?:(?:it|this|that|they|these|those)(?:['’]s|['’]re| is| are| does| do| did| was| were)?|(?:he|she|we|you)(?:['’]s|['’]re| is| are| does| do| did| was| were))\b
rules.fix: State what it is. Drop the straw man it is not.

rules.name: Not only X but also Y
rules.regex: \bnot (?:only|just|merely|simply) [^.!?;\n]{1,80}?\bbut (?:also |rather |even )?
rules.fix: Make one claim. If both halves matter, use two plain sentences.

rules.name: Trailing negation
rules.fix: Keep the positive claim; cut the contrast unless a reader would actually assume the opposite.

rules.name: No X. No Y. Just Z.
rules.fix: Say what it does in one sentence; list the absences only if a reader asked.

rules.name: Analysis tail
rules.regex: ,\s+(?:highlighting|underscoring|emphasi[sz]ing|showcasing|symboli[sz]ing|cementing|solidifying|signall?ing|reinforcing|exemplifying|epitomi[sz]ing) (?:its|the|their|his|her|a|an|how|that|our|your|this|these|both|growing|ongoing|continued|broader|deeper|enduring|significant)\b
rules.fix: Cut the tail, or make its claim a sentence with evidence.

rules.name: Participle tail density
rules.regex: ,\s+(?:ensuring|fostering|reflecting|demonstrating|illustrating|marking|contributing to|paving the way|enabling|empowering|allowing (?:you|users|for|teams)|making it (?:easier|easy|possible|simple|ideal|perfect)|creating a|providing a|offering a)\b
rules.fix: Turn the tail into its own sentence or cut it.

rules.name: Copula avoidance
rules.regex: \b(?:serves|served|serving|stands|stood|acts|acted|functions|functioned|operates|emerges|emerged) as (?:a|an|the|both|one|his|her|its|their)\b|\bboasts? (?:a|an|the|over|more than|some|its|their|\p{N})\b
rules.fix: Use is, are or has.

rules.name: Staged reveal
rules.regex: (?:And )?(?:the (?:result|answer|catch|kicker|twist|best part|secret|truth|reality|problem|fix|solution|takeaway|upshot|difference|verdict|bottom line|outcome|payoff|irony|short answer|real answer|honest answer|short version|real question|real story|good news|bad news)|here['’]s the (?:thing|kicker|catch|deal|twist|truth|secret|best part|problem|rub|key|trick)|spoiler|plot twist|honestly|real talk|hot take)\s*(?:\?(?=\s|$)|:(?=[ \t]+\S))|(?:Why|How) (?:does|is|do) (?:this|that|it) (?:matter|work)\?\s+(?:Because|Simple|It['’]s simple)\b
rules.fix: State the point directly; drop the setup line.

rules.name: Vague attribution
rules.regex: \b(?:experts|researchers|studies|scientists|critics|observers|analysts|industry (?:experts|leaders|reports|observers|insiders)|many (?:experts|people|users|critics|observers)|some (?:experts|people|critics))(?: have)? (?:say|says|said|suggest|suggests|suggested|believe|believes|argue|argues|argued|agree|agrees|note|notes|noted|found|find|show|shows|showed|shown|indicate|indicates|claim|claims|warn|warns|estimate|estimates)\b|\bit (?:is|has been|was) (?:widely |often |commonly |generally |frequently |increasingly )?(?:said|believed|argued|reported|acknowledged|recogni[sz]ed|known|suggested|accepted|thought) that\b(?! you\b)|\b(?:research|science|data|evidence) (?:shows|suggests|indicates|proves|has shown)\b|\baccording to (?:experts|studies|research|many|some|reports)\b
rules.fix: Name the source and the finding, or cut the claim.

rules.name: Whether you're X or Y
rules.fix: Name the one reader this is for and what they get.

rules.name: Rhetorical question opener
rules.regex: (?:(?:Have you )?ever (?:wondered|wished|felt|found yourself|struggled|thought about)|Tired of|Sick of|Fed up with|Struggling (?:to|with)|Wondering (?:how|why|what|whether|if)|Looking for (?:a|an|the) (?:way|tool|app|solution|better)|What if (?:you|there) (?:could|was|were)|Imagine (?:a world|if|being able|never))\b
rules.fix: Open with the fact the question was hinting at.

rules.name: False range
rules.fix: List the actual cases, or name the one that matters.

rules.name: Fragment triplet
rules.fix: Write one sentence that says why the qualities matter together.

rules.name: Uniform sentence rhythm
rules.fix: Vary sentence length: split one long sentence, merge two short ones, let one run.

rules.name: Reflexive triples
rules.fix: Keep a list of three only where all three are needed; otherwise name the one or two that matter.

rules.name: Contrast and corrective framing density
rules.regex: \b(?:it|this|that|they|these|those)(?:(?:['’]s|['’]re| is| are| was| were) not|(?: is| are| was| were)n['’]t) (?!just\b|only\b|merely\b|simply\b|about\b)[^.!?;\n]{1,50}?[,;:—–.]\s*(?:it|this|that|they|these|those)(?:['’]s|['’]re| is| are| was| were)\b|\b(?:rather than|instead of) (?:simply|just|merely)\b|\bshould (?:be treated|be read|be understood|be seen|be viewed|be thought of) as\b|\bdoes not (?:by itself )?(?:establish|imply|guarantee)\b|\bshould not be (?:confused|conflated) with\b|\brather than as\b
rules.fix: Lead with the positive claim; keep a contrast only where readers hold the wrong idea.

rules.name: Less X, more Y
rules.regex: \bless (?:like|about|of) (?:a |an |the )?[\p{L}'’-]+(?: [\p{L}'’-]+){0,3},? (?:and )?more (?:like|about|of)\b|\bless (?:a|an) [\p{L}'’-]+(?: [\p{L}'’-]+){0,2},? (?:and )?more (?:a|an)\b
rules.fix: Say what it is; drop the comparison to what it is less like.

rules.name: Counted announcement
rules.regex: (?:Two|Three|Four|Five|Six|A few|Several|A couple of) (?:things|constraints|reasons|lessons|ideas|factors|forces|principles|questions|points|takeaways|rules|patterns|changes|problems|risks|tradeoffs|trade-offs|caveats|details|decisions|observations|insights)(?: [\p{L}'’-]+){0,4}:
rules.fix: Drop the count-and-colon setup; give the items.

rules.name: Zinger closer
rules.regex: (?:That|This|And that|And this)(?:['’]s| is) the (?:(?:real|whole|actual|entire) (?:point|win|lesson|difference|story|trick|key|catch|problem|unlock|game|magic|secret|question|work)\b|(?:point|win|lesson|difference|story|trick|key|catch|unlock|magic|secret)[.!])|(?:That|This) (?:distinction|difference|detail|part|nuance|choice|order|gap|tradeoff|trade-off|shift|step) (?:matters|counts)[.!]
rules.fix: Cut the closing line; the paragraph already made the point.

rules.name: Performed balance
rules.regex: \bwhile (?:some|many|critics|skeptics|others) (?:might|may|would|could) (?:argue|say|suggest|claim|contend)\b|\bsome (?:might|may|would) (?:argue|say|suggest|claim) that\b|\bon the one hand\b|\bboth (?:sides|camps) (?:have|make) (?:valid|good|fair) points\b
rules.fix: Name who disagrees and why, or state your position without the straw opponent.

rules.name: False agency
rules.regex: \bthe (?:data|numbers|evidence|research|metrics|math|chart|graph|results|story|market|signal|pattern) (?:tells|tell|told|whispers|demands|demand|rewards|reward|punishes|punish|speaks|speak|doesn['’]t lie|don['’]t lie|never lies?)\b|\b(?:speaks|speak) for (?:itself|themselves)\b
rules.fix: Name who measured what and what they found.

rules.name: Same-opener run
rules.fix: Merge the sentences or vary how they open, unless the repetition is the point.

rules.name: Dash in user-facing copy
rules.fix: Use a period, comma, colon or parentheses. For ranges write "to".

rules.name: Dash density
rules.fix: Replace most dashes with periods, commas or parentheses; keep one only where a hard break helps.

rules.name: Arrow in prose
rules.fix: Write the relation as a verb: "renames X to Y", "leads to", "then".

rules.name: Curly quotes or ellipsis character in dev text
rules.fix: Use straight quotes and three periods in commit messages and code comments.

rules.name: Title Case headings
rules.fix: Use sentence case: capitalize the first word and proper nouns only.

rules.name: Bold-label bullets
rules.fix: Write the items as plain sentences, or use a table if they truly are label and value.

rules.name: Bold sprinkled through prose
rules.fix: Remove bold from all but the one phrase a skimmer must not miss.

rules.name: Emoji as heading or bullet decoration
rules.fix: Remove the emoji; let the heading or item text carry the meaning.

rules.name: Emoji density
rules.fix: Cut the emoji to none, or to one where it replaces a word.

rules.name: Headings on short text
rules.fix: Remove the headings; short text reads as paragraphs.

rules.name: List where prose would do
rules.fix: Turn the bullets into sentences that say how the items relate.

rules.name: Markdown where it will not render
rules.fix: Remove the markup; plain-text surfaces show the asterisks and hashes.

rules.name: Exclamation marks in neutral text
rules.fix: End with a period; let the content carry the energy.

rules.name: Stock section heading
rules.regex: ^\s*(?:Key (?:Takeaways?|Highlights|Insights|Points|Considerations|Benefits)|Final Thoughts|In Conclusion|Wrapping Up|Closing Thoughts|The Bottom Line|Bottom Line|Why (?:It|This) Matters|Looking Ahead|Future Outlook|The Road Ahead|Challenges and (?:Considerations|Opportunities|Limitations|Legacy|Future Directions)|Understanding [\p{L}' -]{2,40}|The Future of [\p{L}' -]{2,40}|The Power of [\p{L}' -]{2,40}|Real-World (?:Applications|Examples|Impact|Use Cases)|TL;?DR)\s*[:.]?\s*$
rules.fix: Delete the section, or give it a heading that names its specific content.

rules.name: Invisible character or homoglyph
rules.fix: Delete invisible characters and retype look-alike letters; they break search, copy and screen readers.

rules.name: Hashtag stuffing
rules.fix: Keep one to three hashtags people actually follow.

rules.name: Unicode styled letters
rules.fix: Use plain letters; screen readers spell styled ones out one by one.

rules.name: Padding phrase
rules.regex: \b(?:due to|owing to|in (?:light|view) of|despite|in spite of|given) the fact that\b|\bfirst and foremost\b|\beach and every\b|\bany and all\b|\bat (?:this|that|the present) (?:point in )?time\b|\bfor (?:all )?intents and purposes\b|\bin (?:the )?(?:event|case) that\b|\bfor the purpose of\b|\bwith (?:regard|regards|respect) to\b|\bin (?:close )?proximity to\b|\bon a (?:daily|regular|weekly|monthly|yearly|annual|consistent|case-by-case) basis\b|\bhas the (?:ability|capacity|capability) to\b|\bin the (?:near|not-too-distant|foreseeable) future\b|\bthe vast majority of\b|\ba (?:large|significant|considerable|substantial) (?:number|amount) of\b|\bit goes without saying\b|\bneedless to say\b|\bin and of itself\b
rules.fix: Cut to the short form: because, first, every, now, if, to, about, near, daily, can, soon, most, many.

rules.name: Wordy connector density
rules.regex: \bin order (?:to|for)\b|\bin terms of\b|\bwhether or not\b|\bthe fact that\b|\b(?:is|are) able to\b|\bin the process of\b|\bit is (?:possible|likely|clear|evident) that\b
rules.fix: Shorten: to, about, whether, that, can, now, may.

rules.name: Stacked hedge
rules.regex: \b(?:may|might|could|can) (?:potentially|possibly|perhaps|conceivably)\b|\b(?:potentially|possibly|perhaps) (?:could|may|might|can)\b|\bit (?:may|might|could) be (?:argued|said|suggested|noted) that\b|\bto (?:some|a certain) (?:extent|degree)\b|\b(?:somewhat|fairly|relatively|rather) (?:unique|essential|crucial|critical|vital)\b|\bcan (?:vary|differ) (?:depending on|based on)\b|\bmay or may not\b|\b(?:may|might|could) (?:arguably|ultimately|eventually) (?:unlock|transform|reshape|become|revolutioni[sz]e|redefine|change|prove)\b
rules.fix: Commit to the claim, or name the condition under which it fails.

rules.name: Empty intensifier density
rules.fix: Delete the intensifier, or replace the phrase with one specific word.

rules.name: Subjective ease word
rules.fix: Cut it; show the steps and let the reader judge the effort.

rules.name: Transition-word openers
rules.regex: (?:Additionally|Moreover|Furthermore|Notably|Crucially|Importantly|Interestingly|Significantly|Ultimately|Surprisingly|Unsurprisingly|Undoubtedly|Tellingly|Remarkably|Curiously|Essentially|Fundamentally|Overall|Conversely|Consequently|Subsequently|Firstly|Secondly|Thirdly|Lastly|In addition|That being said|With that being said|Having said that|Equally important|Last but not least|By the same token|To that end|In essence|Indeed)\s*,
rules.fix: Delete most connectives; the order of sentences already carries the logic.

rules.name: Backward or forward reference
rules.regex: \bas (?:mentioned|noted|discussed|stated|outlined|described|highlighted|explained|detailed) (?:above|earlier|previously|before|below|in the previous section)\b|\bthe (?:above|below)(?![\p{L}-])|\babove-mentioned\b|\baforementioned\b
rules.fix: Name the thing again, or link to it.

rules.name: Hedged enumeration opener
rules.regex: There (?:are|is) (?:several|many|a few|a number of|various|numerous|multiple|a variety of|a range of) (?:ways|things|factors|reasons|approaches|options|considerations|benefits|aspects|strategies|steps|types|kinds)\b|It depends on (?:a number of|several|many|various) factors\b|Generally speaking,|In general,
rules.fix: Name the ways or factors directly, or pick the one that applies.

rules.name: AI-era vocabulary
rules.fix: Use the plain word (look at, show, key, many, important) or cut it.

rules.name: Hype and buzzwords
rules.fix: Name the specific capability and its effect; delete the adjective.

rules.name: Hype word in product copy
rules.fix: Name the mechanism: what runs, when, and on what ("checks for duplicates each time you import").

rules.name: "AI" as a selling point
rules.regex: (?<![\p{L}\p{N}_])AI(?:-(?:powered|driven|first|native|enabled|enhanced|assisted|generated|based|infused|fueled|backed))?(?![\p{L}\p{N}_])
rules.fix: Name what the model does and whose model it is ("Claude reads the file names you share"), or cut it.

rules.name: Inflated verb
rules.fix: Use the plain verb: use, help, lead, start, find out, explain, need, include, support, build.

rules.name: Sincerity and intensity adverbs
rules.fix: Delete the adverb; if the sentence goes flat, the claim needs a fact instead.

rules.name: Claude-era idiom
rules.regex: \bload-bearing\b|\b(?:do(?:es)?|doing|did) (?:a lot of|most of the|all the|the) heavy lifting\b|\b(?:earns?|earned|earning) (?:its|their|a) (?:place|keep|spot)\b|\bworth sitting with\b|\b(?:the )?honest (?:answer|take|version|truth) is\b|\b(?:lands|landed) (?:differently|well|hard|softly|flat)\b|\bin a (?:real|meaningful|genuine) (?:way|sense)\b|\bthe (?:quiet|hidden) (?:cost|win|part|work|truth)\b|\bnot nothing\b
rules.fix: Say the literal thing: required, does most of the work, needed.

rules.name: AI-favored word density
rules.fix: Replace most of these with concrete nouns and verbs; one or two per page is fine.

rules.name: First-person plural in product copy
rules.regex: \b(?:we|we['’](?:re|ve|ll|d)|us|our|ours|ourselves)\b
rules.fix: Name the actor: the app, the company or the reader. Turn this on per project in .humanize.json.

rules.name: This commit or PR introduces
rules.regex: \bthis (?:commit|PR|pull request|patch|change(?:set)?|MR|merge request|diff|branch) (?:introduces|adds|implements|updates|refactors|fixes|improves|enhances|removes|aims to|is designed to|ensures|addresses|provides|includes|makes|does|brings|delivers|resolves|streamlines|modifies|contains)\b
rules.fix: Start with what changed and why: "Fix crash when…" or "Sift now…".

rules.name: Vague change note
rules.regex: (?:(?:minor |small |various |misc(?:ellaneous)? |general |some )?(?:bug ?fixes|fixes|improvements|changes|updates|tweaks|enhancements|cleanup|clean-up|polish)(?: and (?:performance |stability |other |minor )?(?:improvements|enhancements|fixes|updates|tweaks))?|update[ds]?|fix(?:ed|es)?|wip|stuff|more (?:fixes|changes)|refactor(?:ing|ed)?)[ \t]*[.!]?[ \t]*$
rules.fix: Name what changed for the reader: the bug, the screen, the new behavior.

rules.name: Tutorial-voice comment
rules.regex: (?:step \d+[:.)]|first,? we\b|now,? we\b|next,? we\b|then,? we\b|finally,? we\b|here,? we\b|here we go\b|let['’]s\b|we (?:need to|will|can|have to) (?:now )?(?:create|define|initiali[sz]e|set up|loop|iterate|check|call|return|import|declare|add|handle)\b)
rules.fix: Say why the code does this, or delete the comment.

rules.name: Comment restates the code
rules.regex: (?:(?:increment|decrement|initiali[sz]e|declare|define|create|instantiate|import|return|call|set|get|loop (?:through|over)|iterate (?:through|over)|check (?:if|whether)) (?:the |a |an |our )?(?:variable|counter|loop|function|method|result|value|array|list|object|instance|class|index|i|j|state|props?)\b|(?:default )?constructor\.?[ \t]*$|getters? (?:and|&) setters?\.?[ \t]*$|end (?:of )?(?:if|for|while|loop|function|class|method)\.?[ \t]*$)
rules.fix: Delete it, or replace it with the reason the code exists.

rules.name: Emoji in log output
rules.regex: (?:console\.(?:log|info|warn|error|debug)|\bprint|\bdebugPrint|\bNSLog|\bos_log|\blogger\.\w+|\blog\.\w+|\bLogger\([^)]*\)\.\w+)\s*\(\s*[`'"][^`'"\n]{0,80}?[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\u{2B50}]
rules.fix: Log plain text; emoji break grep, log parsers and some terminals.

rules.name: Personified code
rules.regex: \b(?:the|this|that|our|your|its) (?:function|method|helper|parser|loop|check|guard|test|tests|docstring|comment|compiler|linter|type ?checker|regex|query|hook|handler|wrapper|API|endpoint|code|caller|callee|cache|scheduler|retry|branch|build|script|gate|rule|scanner|server|client) (?:promises|bites|lies|forgets|insists|refuses|pretends|believes|hates|loves|happily|quietly|cheerfully|politely|honestly)\b
rules.fix: Describe the behavior literally: returns, ignores, fails when.

rules.name: Assurance language in change descriptions
rules.regex: \b(?:improv|enhanc)(?:e|es|ed|ing) (?:the )?(?:overall )?(?:clarity|readability|flow|consistency|maintainability|robustness|reliability|user experience|UX|code quality|structure|organi[sz]ation)\b|\b(?:streamlin|refin|polish|tighten)(?:e|es|ed|ing) (?:the )?(?:code|logic|flow|tone|wording|implementation|structure|process|copy|language)\b|\bwhile (?:preserving|maintaining|keeping|retaining) (?:the )?(?:existing|original|current|same|overall|core)\b|\bensur(?:e|es|ed|ing) (?:that )?(?:consistency|robustness|reliability|maintainability|clarity|proper|correct|seamless|smooth|optimal|a (?:seamless|smooth|consistent|robust))\b|\b(?:implement|add|introduc|creat)(?:e|es|ed|ing|s)? (?:a |an )?(?:comprehensive|robust|complete|full-featured|seamless|intelligent|advanced|sophisticated) [\p{L}-]+
rules.fix: Say what changed and what it fixes; drop the quality adjectives.

rules.name: Done-report language
rules.regex: \bsuccessfully (?:implemented|completed|added|updated|fixed|created|integrated|refactored|resolved|migrated|deployed|tested|verified|built)\b|\bI(?:['’]ve| have) (?:successfully )?(?:completed|finished) (?:the|all|your) (?:implementation|task|changes|requested)\b
rules.fix: Say what changed; "successfully" adds nothing a reader can check.

rules.name: Change-history comment
rules.regex: \b(?:previously|formerly) (?:we|this|it|the code|the function|used|was|were|did|had)\b|\bused to (?:be|use|call|return|do)\b|\b(?:was|were) changed (?:to|from)\b|\bchanged from\b|\bno longer (?:uses|calls|returns|needs)\b|\bnow uses\b|\bupdated to use\b|\bas discussed\b|\b(?:AI|agent|Claude|Copilot|ChatGPT|GPT|Cursor)(?:-generated| generated)\b|\bthis (?:function|method|class|file|helper) was (?:added|created|introduced|written) to\b
rules.fix: Describe the code as it is; the history goes in the commit message.

rules.name: Letter form in dev text
rules.regex: \bDear (?:[\p{L}-]+ )?(?:Team|Maintainers?|Developers?|Sir|Madam|Hiring Manager|Reviewers?)\b|\b(?:Best|Kind|Warm|Warmest) regards\b|\bThank you for your time and consideration\b|\bSincerely,|\bI hope this (?:message|PR|pull request|issue|comment) finds you well\b
rules.fix: Drop the salutation and sign-off; open with the change or the problem.
